headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 12, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-6 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Chase DeLauter leading the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, including a home run. Drew Anderson pitched 4 strong innings for the Guardians, striking out 4 batters.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen, who has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Other notable injuries include Isiah Kiner-Falefa (Boston Red Sox), Kervin Castro (New York Yankees), Hunter Greene (Cincinnati Reds), Jameson Taillon (Toronto Blue Jays), Kyle Stowers (Miami Marlins), Daniel Susac (San Francisco Giants), and Tyler Freeman (Colorado Rockies).

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the trade of Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade. Other notable trades include the Miami Marlins trading Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals, and the Athletics acquiring Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 4-6 victory over the Cleveland Guardians in their recent matchup. Chase DeLauter led the Guardians' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Drew Anderson pitched 4 strong innings for the Guardians, striking out 4 batters.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Pirates in 2-0 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 2-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eury Pérez pitching 7.0 innings of shutout baseball, striking out 7 and walking 2. Esteury Ruiz led the Pirates' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Nationals 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured an 8-6 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Seiya Suzuki leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Jacob Webb earned the save with 1.1 scoreless innings, striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners suffered a 4-1 loss to the New York Yankees in a one-sided contest. Randy Arozarena led the Mariners' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Dodgers' Treinen Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers right-handed pitcher Blake Treinen has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade. The trade was made with the Boston Red Sox.
